A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SHAREDLLM paper. All 20 pages, including equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A-D, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original language-modeling and long-context benchmark results, ablations, passkey retrieval tests, and efficiency measurements in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1-4, the appendix experiments, and the passkey retrieval results in Figure 5.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Algorithm 1 retain the same context-tree construction, branch selection, KV compression, self-injection architecture, positional handling, and training objective.

E1.justification: Training sources and evaluated coverage are unchanged: language modeling on Arxiv, PG19, ProofPile, and CodeParrot; LongBench and Infini-Bench tasks; and appendix passkey retrieval.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding tables and figures, including PI, YaRN, CEPE, StreamingLLM, LongAlpaca, Activation Beacon, SnapKV, and OmniKV where originally evaluated.

E3.justification: Sections 3.1-3.2 and the appendices retain the same model configurations, training lengths, evaluation metrics, truncation practices, and sample counts, including 1,000 perplexity examples except for 10 at 128K.

E4.justification: The design ablations, tree-height/compression sensitivity studies, Books3 analysis, branch-policy comparisons, efficiency sweeps, and tree-splitting example are unchanged in Section 3.4 and Appendices A-D.

E5.justification: Appendix A.5 specifies the same five runs with different random seeds. Table 9 retains identical uncertainty reporting, with no added statistical procedures.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and plotted findings are unchanged throughout. For example, SHAREDLLM retains 2.46 perplexity on Arxiv at 32K in Table 1 and 30.93 MD-QA for LLaMA-2 in Table 3.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(7), the training-loss formula, mathematical definitions, and complexity reasoning are unchanged. No proofs or formal results are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning self-injection, generalization from 8K training to over 128K inputs, competitive accuracy, and inference efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of tree granularity, query awareness, Books3 effects, baseline truncation, and efficiency remain unchanged, including the discussion of query-aware retrieval overhead in Appendix C.

D1.justification: Hardware, optimization settings, hyperparameters, dataset preparation, pseudocode, and code-access disclosures are unchanged. Appendix A retains identical implementation and reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography entries, and research positioning in Section 4 are unchanged. Reference-page differences result from reflow.

P1.justification: v2 adds Soujanya Poria and the Nanyang Technological University affiliation, updates affiliation indices, and changes the version/date stamp. Scientific prose, headings, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author block accompanies modest spacing and pagination changes: Figure 3 shifts downward on page 7, and the acknowledgment moves from page 10 to page 11. Figure/table content is unchanged, and appendix pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The author/affiliation update and minor reflow leave the scientific content, empirical support, reproducibility information, and substantive readability unchanged. The identical appendix material further supports no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
